query: i'm pitching this idea to my co-founder tomorrow and i want to show her what the app would look like. it's a meal planning saas — there's a weekly calendar view, a recipe search page, and a grocery list screen. can you wireframe all three so i can walk her through the flow?

can you build me a quick lo-fi prototype of a b2b invoicing tool? needs a dashboard with recent invoices, a create invoice form, and a client list. doesn't need to look polished, just functional enough to test with users
mockup a checkout flow for my ecommerce store — cart summary, shipping address form, payment step, and order confirmation. clickable between screens would be ideal

i need to sketch out the ui for a kanban board app before we start building. something like trello — columns for todo/in-progress/done, cards you can click into, a sidebar with project list. balsamiq-style is exactly what i'm going for

hey can you draft the screens for a mobile onboarding flow? it's for a fitness tracker. step 1 asks for name/age, step 2 asks for fitness goals, step 3 shows a summary and lets them start. keep it low fidelity

i'm doing a design sprint next week and need a rough prototype of our new admin panel to show the team. it should have a nav sidebar, a users table with search/filter, and a user detail modal. hand-drawn style is fine
generate a wireframe for a project management tool with three screens: project list, project detail with gantt chart area, and a team members page

i want to visualize the user flow for my saas app before writing any code. starting screen is a landing page with pricing, then signup, then an onboarding wizard. can you build that out as a clickable prototype?
prototype a customer support dashboard — ticket queue on the left, ticket detail on the right with reply box, status dropdown, and assignee field. we're using react so build it in react
i need to show my client what the homepage of their new site could look like — hero section, features grid, testimonials, pricing table, footer. nothing fancy, just a rough layout they can react to
my app.tsx is getting really messy — it's a react dashboard and i've got like 600 lines of jsx in one file. can you help me split it into components and clean it up?
i already built the wireframes in figma, now i need to convert the designs to actual react components with tailwind. here's the figma link
can you add wired-elements to my existing vue project? i'm already using vuetify and i'm not sure if they'll conflict
what's the difference between wired-elements and shoelace for building a web components library? trying to decide which one to use
build me a full production-ready landing page for my saas startup. needs to look professional, with animations, a dark mode toggle, and real brand colors (#1a2b3c). next.js + tailwind
i have a hand-drawn sketch of my app's layout (attached as a photo). can you review it and give feedback on the ux — does the navigation make sense? are there any obvious usability issues?
help me pick a color palette for my new dashboard. i'm going for a clean, modern look — maybe something with a dark sidebar and light content area. what do you recommend?
i need to add about 30 icons to my react app. i want hand-drawn / doodle style icons. what library should i use and how do i install it?
we have an existing html prototype that a designer made and i need to turn it into a react app. the html is in /public/prototype.html. can you help with the conversion?
my react component is re-rendering too many times. i have a DataTable component in src/components/DataTable.tsx that fetches from /api/users on every render. how do i fix it?
